verdicts.reason: Both scramble the reading order: '$199 / New York / from' now reads as nonsense when it should be 'New York from $199'. Both also run the suitcase almost edge to edge vertically, with a big empty gap between the text block and the Book button. A keeps a readable Meridian logo, but it is shrunk and stuck awkwardly in the bottom-left beside the suitcase wheels, lined up with nothing. B's logo is an illegible speck under the text, and its 'from' and Book button are tiny too, so the brand effectively disappears. That makes B the weaker of the two.
